text:
Aurelia Air will open its new hub at Castellane Airfield on 14 March 2026, the airline confirmed this week.

Marguerite Delacroix-Venn, Aurelia Air's Chief Operating Officer, confirmed the launch date. I was among those at the public ceremony on 9 January 2026, where the Castellane Airfield Authority and the airline signed the Hub Development Agreement that makes the plan official.

The hub will begin operating with 18 daily departures. According to the agreement, it will also create about 1,200 local jobs, a figure that drew visible interest from many residents who attended the signing.

The agreement sets out the terms under which Aurelia Air will base its operations at the field. With the opening date now fixed, the airline's arrival marks a significant change for the airfield, which has long been a quiet part of the area's transport network.

The Gazette will report further as the March opening approaches.
